about: S. S. Oskanov Airport is 30 km north-east of Magas, on the western outskirts of the stanitsa of Ordzhonikidzevskaya, 2 km from Sleptsovskaya railway station. Operator: JSC Magas International Airport named after S. S. Oskanov. The terminal is equipped for border and customs control.

terminals.title: Terminal
terminals.text: One terminal building (passenger terminal). It has facilities for border, immigration, customs, veterinary and sanitary-quarantine control. Capacity: 150 passengers per hour.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: VIP lounge in a separate building: waiting area, bar area. Service on advance request, paid at airport rates. There is a transfer to and from the aircraft steps and a paid VIP car park for those meeting and seeing off passengers.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi access in the terminal building.
